assets.name: table
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background for a 2D top-down multiplayer tavern card game, landscape 1536 by 1024.
Create a richly hand-painted, atmospheric old tavern gambling tabletop viewed perfectly vertically from directly overhead, completely flat plan view, not isometric, no perspective or horizon. A large rectangular table fills 96 percent of the image, very gently rounded corners, chunky dark carved walnut rim with worn edges, slender aged brass inlay, dark deep petrol-green wool felt surface with fine fibers, worn scuffs, a few faint glass-ring marks, subtle scratches. A very small ornate brass compass-like floral engraving at exact center, mostly empty felt for gameplay, corners have restrained tiny Art Nouveau gilt ornaments. Moody warm amber lamplight from upper left, soft teal shadow at lower right, tactile believable materials, elegant illustrated board game art, crisp sophisticated detail, painterly digital illustration rather than plastic 3D. Table aligned with image edges and entire outer rim visible, narrow dark wood floor outside, center empty. No people, no heads, no arms, no guns, no playing cards, no chips, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. Subdued medium-value background so cream playing cards will read clearly.

assets.name: male-0
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent PNG 2D game character sprite, landscape 1024x1024. For a finely hand-painted dark tavern gambling game. True straight-down bird's-eye view of a seated adult gambler at the SOUTH edge of a card table, looking toward TOP of image. Show ONLY a cropped strip of upper chest at the BOTTOM edge with two clothed arms bending and reaching toward the TOP. Two hands resting relaxed, one left and one right, clearly separated with transparent empty space between. The head, neck, face, hair, legs and lower body are COMPLETELY OUT OF FRAME BELOW the bottom edge. Chest is an intentional boundary crop at bottom, NOT a headless standing bust. Two arms have correct human anatomy, five fingers per hand, graceful natural poses, foreshortened overhead. Hands and forearms occupy middle-upper area, wrists natural. Fine brushed illustrative realism, detailed fabric seams, credible fingers, aged brass clothing accents, warm candle highlights upper-left, cool desaturated shadows. No table or cards or gun, no props, no ground plane, no text, no watermark. Genuine transparent background with alpha, clean silhouette edges, no checkerboard painted into image, no backdrop. Leave small transparent margins left/right/top.
Outfit: Adult male with elegant midnight navy wool coat, white rolled shirt cuffs, charcoal waistcoat, subtly weathered hands.
